## Protocol versions

| Name | Value | Where it is on the wire |
| --- | --- | --- |
| v1 control handshake | `POCKETDESK_HELLO 1` | TCP greeting, `protocol::HANDSHAKE_HELLO` |
| v1 version | `1` | the `1` in the greeting above |
| KDE Connect identity `protocolVersion` | `1` | `kdeconnect.identity`, a separate namespace |
| Pocketdesk extension `llVersion` | `1` | every `kdeconnect.pocketdesk.*` packet (R4 D4) |
| v2 negotiated range | `2-2` | `IdentityPacketV2` min/max, QUIC stream 0 |
| Control payload ceiling | `16777216` bytes | framed v2 control JSON |
| Ports | control `1716/tcp`, media `4716/udp` | `DEFAULT_CONTROL_PORT`, `DEFAULT_STREAMING_PORT` |

## Transports

| Id | What it carries | Address | ALPN | In this build | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tcp-v1` | KDE Connect-style control channel | `tcp://0.0.0.0:1716` | — | yes | plugin traffic (clipboard, battery, notifications, files); the plane Phase 3 retires |
| `quic-v2` | QUIC multiplexer: media + control | `udp://0.0.0.0:4716` | `pocketdesk-v2` | yes | negotiated over LAN addresses and tailnet IPs alike |
| `quic-v1-stream` | QUIC streaming (pre-v2 handshake) | `udp://0.0.0.0:4716` | `pocketdesk-stream` | yes | offered on the same port; the server dispatches on the ALPN the peer picks |
| `iroh-noq` | iroh hole-punched WAN endpoint | `address-free (endpoint id over any link)` | `pocketdesk-v2` | yes | behind the `wan` feature; the Android bridge builds with it |

## Capture backends

`Auto` attempts, in order: Windows `wgc -> dxgi`. A config file may still name a Linux backend; it is refused at capture time with its name.

| Backend | `capture_backend` value | Auto rank (Windows) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Wgc` | `"wgc"` | 1 |
| `Dxgi` | `"dxgi"` | 2 |

## Codecs

| Video | This build encodes | Client capability bit | MediaCodec MIME | FFmpeg encoder |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| H.264 | yes | assumed for every client | `video/avc` | `h264` |
| H.265 (HEVC) | yes | `FD 00` caps stream, bit `0b00000001` | `video/hevc` | `hevc` |

| Audio direction | Codec | This build encodes | Rate | Channels | Bitrate | Frame | Receiving end plays it |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| desktop -> phone | Opus | yes | 48000 Hz | 2 | 64000 bit/s | 20 ms | yes |
| phone -> desktop | Opus | yes | 48000 Hz | 1 | set by the sender | 20 ms | yes |

On Windows the `phone -> desktop` direction plays into a virtual audio cable (VB-CABLE's "CABLE Input" by default, or `mic_relay_device` in config.toml), since a program cannot create a microphone without a driver; apps record from the cable's other end. With no cable installed the relay says so and drops the audio.
